title: Update update-browserlist.yml to fix deprecation and action fails
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Brief description about the content of your PR.

Changes `npx browserslist --update-db` command to `npx update-browserslist-db` as the former command is [deprecated](https://github.com/browserslist/browserslist/pull/791).

Resolves _the action fails_ :slightly_smiling_face:

comments.body:
```suggestion
      - run: npx update-browserslist-db@latest
```

What error is happening with this?

comments.author: Abrifq
comments.body: Package sees pnpm-lock file and tries to use pnpm, which is not installed in the environment.
